title: Normalized ordinary scalar adjunctions preserve complete objects
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $d$ an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], $B$ normalized strict scalar balancing, $f:U\to V$ a scheme morphism and $P$ a normalized $\mathrm{PullCompatibility}$ for $B$ [lem-weil-pbc-strict-quotient-scalar-balancing]. The supplied completed- and constant-coefficient ordinary unbounded derived pullbacks $L^a:D(A_V)\to D(A_U)$ and $L^0:D(\underline A_V)\to D(\underline A_U)$ admit right adjoints $R^a,R^0$ and a natural isomorphism $\chi:R^ar_V\cong r_UR^0$ equal to the mate of $P.a^{-1}$, with $r_U,r_V$ scalar restriction and composition in execution order. Both $R^a$ and $R^0$ preserve the published intrinsic derived ideal completeness predicate [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]. There is no geometric restriction on $f$.

lean.statement:
theorem strictScalarOrdinaryAdjunction (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (B : Balancing d)
    {U V : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ V)
    (P : PullCompatibility f d (B.ρ V) (B.ρ U)) :
    ∃ (rightA : D (ring U d true) ⥤ D (ring V d true))
      (right0 : D (ring U d false) ⥤ D (ring V d false))
      (adjA : P.completed.ordinary ⊣ rightA)
      (adj0 : P.constant.ordinary ⊣ right0)
      (χ : rightA ⋙ dres (scalar V d) ≅ dres (scalar U d) ⋙ right0),
      χ.hom = (mateEquiv adjA adj0 (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ P.a.inv)).natTrans ∧
      (∀ N : D (ring U d true), IsComplete (finiteMap (topology U) A d.ideal true 0) N →
        IsComplete (finiteMap (topology V) A d.ideal true 0) (rightA.obj N)) ∧
      (∀ N : D (ring U d false), IsComplete (finiteMap (topology U) A d.ideal false 0) N →
        IsComplete (finiteMap (topology V) A d.ideal false 0) (right0.obj N))
